annotation.title_clean: Latin American Artificial Intelligence Index (ILIA) Reconfirms Chile, Brazil and Uruguay as Leaders in the Region
annotation.title_en: Latin American Artificial Intelligence Index (ILIA) Reconfirms Chile, Brazil and Uruguay as Leaders in the Region
annotation.authors_or_issuer: ECLAC (UN Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean)
annotation.summary_en: ECLAC press release presenting the 2024 Latin American AI Index (ILIA) led by CENIA, ranking 19 countries on enabling factors, R&D and adoption, and governance. Chile, Brazil and Uruguay lead as pioneers. It notes talent gaps, gender gaps and regional cooperation; there is no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Chile (73.07), Brazil (69.30), Uruguay (64.98) top the ILIA 2024 among 19 countries
Region has doubled AI talent concentration but remains below Global North levels
Chile's governance noted for long-term policy and legal certainty
Gender equity in AI R&D remains a challenge
EU-LAC Digital Alliance supports cooperation on AI
